title: The Return
description: A woman in a long dark coat stands in a derelict warehouse, reaching toward a large chaotic board covered in pinned photographs, newspaper clippings, and string. A glowing halo-like light surrounds her head as she holds a small photograph, with an overturned easel, scattered papers and broken lights on the dusty floor around her.
prompt: A lone woman in a long dark Victorian-style coat stands in an abandoned industrial warehouse at dusk, reaching with one hand toward a massive conspiracy board covered in photos, red string, newspaper clippings and burning images. She holds a small glowing photograph in her other hand. A bright ethereal halo rings her head. Overturned easel with a painting, broken lights and scattered papers lie on the concrete floor. Cinematic lighting with cool blue and purple tones mixed with warm amber highlights, moody and mysterious atmosphere.
